name: Target Regional Distribution Center Logan Township (T3857)

fieldNotes.truckGate: Multi-lane canopied gatehouse at the south truck entrance (z20/z21 sat): a wide overhead canopy spans the lanes with a booth island beneath and lane striping running through it where the access drive meets the property.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Staffed booth visible under the entrance canopy island (small white structure set between the truck lanes beside the gate), distinct from the main building ~700 m to the north.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because a physical guard booth is present at the gate.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: West face has a continuous line of trailers backed into dock doors along the entire ~700 m wall (z18 west/SW views) plus doors on the NW face; well into 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Dedicated fenced drop yard north of the building packed with rows of parked trailers (z18 dropyard view), 100+ trailer stalls; 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Separate gated trailer-storage lot on the north side of the property, distinct from the active west dock apron.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Single-sided dock building (docks on west face only); east face is employee/auto parking, so no separate ship/rcv dock clusters.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long looping access drive from the Rt 322 / interchange ramp to the gate provides deep stacking for 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide multi-lane canopied gate apron with room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 2 inbound from canopy lane striping; exact split with exit lanes not fully resolvable from overhead.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Logan Township edge-of-town setting surrounded by farmland, wetlands and woods despite the industrial park; classified Rural per rubric tie-breaker.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~78 acres derived from the traced perimeter polygon (1.1M sq ft building footprint plus yard, drop yard, and parking).
